scope: Final source-only review for a wait-only,zero-input,root-only SIGKILL calibration and GET-only restart. Approves the recorded no-input execution design only; no GUI/E2E/compile/process/signal/signature invocation or runtime acceptance is performed by this review.

intermediateV2Boundary.statusAtSourceReview: Wait-only narrowed scope closed input hazards, but N7 finalization/provider/raw-pipe failures and smaller ps/receipt followups were still open. No v2 execution or final approval was made.
intermediateV2Boundary.oldOriginalSourceHashLimitation: Original balanced-prefix sources were read before authorized edits but not raw-hash archived; prior v1 report explicitly retains this limitation. No old hash was reconstructed.

findingResolutions.resolution: The only macro action is wait(seconds30),delay0. There are no input/focus actions before or after it. performance.now is captured before the stream request; final pending/no-tool-result, fresh exact root birth/live child and elapsed<15000ms are checked immediately before positive-PID SIGKILL. Late/changed precondition throws without fault injection.

No keyboard or pointer mutation is scheduled by the calibration, so failure cleanup cannot interrupt a fixture-generated held pair. The receiver never posts input or changes source/clipboard. This does not qualify destructive cleanup for any future input-bearing macro.

Original pre-fault rows persist separately. Normal product-exit observation occurs before any child signal. If original birth identities remain, the test explicitly fails/retains and separately records externalIntervention, rechecking PID+creation before TERM/KILL and awaiting disappearance. Intervened exit cannot become product automatic-exit PASS.

The receiver identity-only mode calls getpgid/getsid without creating NSApplication. Initial birth-aware tree rows bracket numeric identity and ps -ww command reads with another matching-birth snapshot. PPID ancestry binds native→ACC→primary→guardian→original root; all supervised nodes share guardian PID as PGID/SID, while receiver PGID differs. Root/receiver may share the independent runner group. No observer duplicates private control FD3.

No sourcePID/point attribution is asserted because no input_sequence is dispatched. Initial/final fault preconditions explicitly require empty left-event receipts and zero counts/otherInput; subsequent state checks require zero counts and neutral HID/combined modifiers. Receipt collection remains observational. Future input/held tests must separately qualify attribution and rescue.

Geometry comparisons use explicit x/y/width/height fields and input-source comparisons use id/type. Final fault preflight repeats neutral/zero counts/empty receipts, geometryOK/frontmost, fixed geometry/source and no other input, avoiding NSDictionary key enumeration order.

Snapshots include isolated sessions, Node logs and ACC logs, labeled non-atomic. Each service generation stdout/stderr is retained. File-write/close callbacks record archiveErrors/failure; fault injection rejects these errors. Provider/receiver cleanup paths are independently guarded; receiver fallback checks exact owned rows, complete receipt and disappearance. Output closure, terminal snapshot and final helper hash are guarded. Helper initial hash is cached; terminal result write has a retained-root terminal-incomplete fallback. Errors retain failure/roots and cannot be promoted to calibration pass.

metadataReview.note: Only new E2E/receiver plus the five README/facts/static inventory updates are part of this candidate. Parent-reported syntax/compiler/static results are not reviewer executions.

faultAndObservationContract.signal: Only birth-verified original Workbench positive PID receives the injected SIGKILL. No group/tree signal substitutes for the fault.
faultAndObservationContract.automaticExit: Original guardian/primary/ACC/native birth-set disappearance is observed before separately labeled external residual cleanup. This measures observed process exits, not durable product cleanup receipts or input release.
faultAndObservationContract.timing: Monotonic stream-start<15s is conservative relative to the sole30s wait and is checked again before signal. Node pending/no-result and allowed request are explicit.
faultAndObservationContract.dispatchEvidenceLimit: Approval plus active Node execution is not by itself a durable proof of ACC entering its await wait. Runtime records must distinguish approved/pending invocation, actual dispatch evidence if present, and missing/unknown attribution. Do not relabel this as a guaranteed wait-entry ACK or whole hard-abort gate pass.
faultAndObservationContract.restart: Same isolated data root, auto background/model/tool generation disabled; only GET health/session requests after restart, receiver state and unchanged fake-provider request count over the measured interval. No chat/replay/resume POST is issued.
faultAndObservationContract.durableEvidence: Raw session/Node/ACC files are copied with hashes at pre-kill/post-kill/post-restart/terminal stages. Copies are cross-file non-atomic observations; absence of a macro row is unknown/incomplete attribution, not not-dispatched or success.
faultAndObservationContract.archiveFailure: Archive/cleanup/hash/output-close errors mark failure or retained state; if both primary and fallback storage writes fail only console/root-location evidence can remain. No successful durable-write guarantee is inferred in that failure case.

claimLimits: No actual pointer/keyboard input, input-source change, clipboard operation, TCC change or lock. No held-input cleanup or independently qualified rescue is implemented or accepted.
No original HA-S1/S2/S3/S4 hard-abort durability/release gate is closed by source review or by a future successful neutral calibration alone.
No whole macro success, durable correlated interrupted outcome, automatic replay safety outside the observed GET-only interval, App/Windows/minimum-OS/display/formal identity coverage is inferred.
Future runtime must freeze sources/artifacts, use actual authorized helper1cc and separate isolated evidence, keep first failure and bind raw topology/snapshots/state/outputs to the execution.
